name: Gremlin
text:
Gremlins are the fey embodiments of ruin and decay. In grand philosophical terms, one might view them as minor avatars of entropy—nature's ceaseless assault on all the works of civilization. They are rot, they are erosion, they are disrepair. They are the quirk or ironic fate that unravels a perfectly laid-out plan or the string of petty annoyances behind a tremendously bad day. All that civilization has built came first from dust, and to dust it will return, and the gremlins will be there to usher it along.

Mostly, though, gremlins love to break things, usually in an enthusiastic manner and while wearing a sharp grin. Gremlins are nothing if not servants of the perverse. A common gremlin saying is, "Everything that can go wrong will go wrong if I have anything to say about it."
